title: Dimension edge boundary fraction
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, taking values in $\{\pm1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The dimension edge boundary fraction at $i$ is the uniform probability, among sign vectors $x$ with $x_i=1$, that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{\pm1\}$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
